thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Critical auth failures for NovaPay (private VPC). High error rate hitting dedicated pool auth (OIDC token exchange failures + mTLS handshake errors). Paging @oncall.

mike.s: saw the alert — 15:29 UTC spike in 401/403 from nova-pay dedicated nodes.

jordan.k: confirming, dashboards show token-exchange error 502 from our idp-proxy service and TLS handshake  alert for backend-connector.

ashley.p: customer reported jobs failing in prod, they say they rotated keys this morning. Nova support pinged our SRE on their side 15:10.

nova-support: we rotated an OIDC client secret and pushed new certs to our endpoints. We thought rollout was staged. Seeing some retries time out.

mike.s: steps i'm taking: 1) hit token endpoint with curl to verify token exchange result 2) check kube logs for idp-proxy 3) run openssl against customer mTLS endpoint.

infra-bot: alert: nova-pay-dedicated-pool-3: 79% 401s, 12% 403s, avg latency 1.9s.

mike.s: curl output against token endpoint: "{\"error\":\"invalid_client\",\"error_description\":\"Client authentication failed\"}" so OIDC client secret mismatch.

jordan.k: kubectl logs idp-proxy -n redwood-prod | tail -n 50 -> showing: 
```
2025-09-03T15:27:12Z WARN token exchange failed: invalid_client
2025-09-03T15:27:13Z ERROR mTLS handshake failed: certificate verify failed: certificate has expired
```

ashley.p: two distinct failures then: OIDC client secret mismatch AND expired cert on mTLS path. Could be a simultaneous customer rollout that missed a node.

mike.s: mitigation options: 
- quick: fallback to cached service account token for nova-pay for 30m to restore traffic (requires infra approval)
- medium: ask Nova to revert to previous client secret or provide new secret via secure channel now
- long: bake support for secondary client creds and cert hot-swap in control plane (postmortem item)

jordan.k: I can perform the cached-token fallback but need approval from infra lead. Also need to whitelist a temporary bypass for the dedicated pool to accept our signed short-lived tokens. This is tenant-specific, will not affect other customers.

ashley.p: contact infra lead @marta? she's OOO today. @infra-bot, escalate to infra-oncall.

infra-bot: Escalation created: infra-oncall (pager) — incident #INC-20250903-1545.

mike.s: While we wait, I'm going to try openssl to confirm cert expiry: `openssl s_client -connect nova-idp.internal:443 -showcerts` -> peer cert: notAfter = Sep 3 14:58:00 2025 GMT (EXPIRED).

nova-support: confirmed — our ops pushed a cert rotation at 14:45 but one internal load balancer failed to pick up the new cert. We're rolling it back now.

jordan.k: good. once they revert or fix load balancer, token exchange should succeed. I'm prepping commands to rotate our client secret config as a fallback: 
```
# update secret in k8s (redwood idp-proxy)
kubectl -n redwood-prod create secret generic nova-oidc --from-literal=client_secret=REDACTED --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

mike.s: log note: we've seen spike in retries causing queue pressure. I'm scaling idp-proxy to x3 temporarily: `k scale deploy/idp-proxy --replicas=6 -n redwood-prod`

ashley.p: customer impact assessment: NovaPay payment ingestion is degraded for ~30% of requests (retries causing timeouts). No data loss; jobs queued or retried. SLAs at risk for high throughput customers. Need to maintain calling channels with Nova.

infra-bot: infra-oncall accepted escalation, paging marta (infra-oncall).

marta (infra-oncall): I'm on it. Please keep me posted. Jordan, you have approval to apply cached-token fallback if you think it will reduce customer impact immediately.

jordan.k: applying cached-token fallback now (will tag and revert in 30m). Config change: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/tenants/nova/fallback_token_enable` -> response 200. Switching routing to use cached tokens for nova-pay.

mike.s: outgoing traffic to nova-pay dedicated pool auth errors dropping ~90% now, 5xx -> 200 observed on sample. Load stable.

nova-support: we're finishing rollback, LB picked up old certs. We'll confirm token endpoint in 2-3m.

jordan.k: re-run token exchange test: success, got id_token and access_token. `curl -X POST https://nova-idp.internal/oauth/token -d 'grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=redwood'` returns 200.

mike.s: removing temporary scaling after stable: `k scale deploy/idp-proxy --replicas=3 -n redwood-prod`.

ashley.p: customer impact update to ops: NovaPay degraded for ~35 minutes between 15:10-15:45 UTC, recovered after cached-token fallback + customer rollback. No cross-tenant impact. Action items: 1) add health-check for cert sync across their LB pool 2) improve secret rotation docs + support checklist 3) implement secondary creds hot-swap.

jordan.k: creating incident postmortem skeleton and RFC for secondary creds; tagging as P1 follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, assignee=jordan.k, incident_id=INC-20250903-1545.

mike.s: handoff to Jordan for postmortem and customer comms. I'll drop link to logs and timings in the incident doc.

jordan.k: acknowledged. I'll draft the message for Nova and schedule a joint runbook session tomorrow 09:00 PST.

ashley.p: thanks team. marking thread resolved for paging; keep updates here for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
